sources.title: ZURU Toys | Play Reimagined.
sources.snippet:
The XSHOT Excel Turbo Advance has a 40-dart capacity barrel to take out multiple targets from up to 24m / 80 feet with accuracy and power! Flick the side switch to swap between layers of darts in the barrel to continue blasting your way to victory. The easy prime mechanism and detachable barrel refill means it’s never been easier to make it rain over the competition. Contains a mega 96 darts in pack!
